filament_notes:
SUNLU manufacturer data, generated by scripts/shop_profiles/gen_filaments.py.
Dry 60 C for 8 h.
Manufacturer max speed 400 mm/s.
Max volumetric speed raised to 18 mm3/s (printer profile 12) from the manufacturer's 400 mm/s rating, capped at 18 for this printer.
Temperature set for ~200 mm/s on this printer: 245 C (first layer 245 C). Manufacturer bands: 240-250 C at 100-300 mm/s; 260-270 C at 300-600 mm/s. Printing much faster or slower than this printer's default process? Adjust the nozzle temperature along those bands.
Product page table: 240-260C / <=400mm/s; marketing 'up to 600mm/s'. uk.store listing: speed table 205-215C @50-100, 240-250C @100-300, 260-270C @300-600mm/s; drying oven 60-65C, SUNLU S4/E2 dryer 65C >=8h. Shore (HA/HD) 79. Wiki: fan ON.
Source: https://www.sunlu.com/products/high-speed-matte-petg-filament
Shop tuning: 2026-10-11, Plus 4 with Conch hotend: sparse infill strung and left clumps the nozzle knocked loose at 245 C, 40% fan, 0.8 mm retraction. Use 240 C (bottom of SUNLU's 100-300 mm/s band), fan up to 60%, retraction 1.0 mm at 40 mm/s, and pair with the process '0.20mm PETG Standard @Qidi XPlus4' (gyroid infill, 150 mm/s, 5000 mm/s2). Dry before use.
